data.one_liner: State management library bridging BLoC semantics with signals primitives.
data.what_it_does: Bridges the Business Logic Component (BLoC) pattern with reactive signals primitives to provide synchronous state management. It features event concurrency transformers, VM Service telemetry, and stream interop extensions.
use_when: You want BLoC-style architecture with synchronous state propagation.
You need fine-grained reactive updates using signals primitives.
You require event concurrency transformers like Mutex, droppable, or sequential.
avoid_when: You prefer the standard asynchronous Stream-based bloc package.
You are using a completely different state management approach like Riverpod or Provider.
strengths: Synchronous state propagation without microtask delays.
Built-in DevTools telemetry and observer support.
weaknesses: Adds an extra conceptual layer combining signals and BLoC semantics.
Requires adherence to its specific synchronous lifecycle contract.
data.setup_notes: Add bloc_signals to dependencies in pubspec.yaml.

alternatives.name: bloc
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose standard package:bloc if you want the classic stream-based BLoC architecture without signals primitives.

alternatives.name: riverpod
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose riverpod if you prefer a global provider and compilation-safe dependency injection approach to reactive state management.
